origin: operator report: local checkouts silently stale
objective: Keep safe clean Git checkouts current on a deterministic 15-minute cadence.
need: Operators need visibility and safe fast-forwarding without touching local work.
purpose: Synchronize ordinary local checkouts while preserving unsafe work.
consumer: Home Manager user service and operators reading status.json/coordination warnings.
contract: Fetch upstreams; fast-forward clean strict-behind trees; backup and advance equivalent-patch stale trees; never mutate dirty or unique-local trees; record every result.
failureBoundary: A checkout-level failure is recorded and isolated; other checkouts continue.
falsifier: Fixture shows a dirty or unique-local checkout changed, or status omits a discovered checkout.
invariants: One warning per checkout per UTC day

assumptions.statement: Git upstream metadata is available through @{u}.
assumptions.falsifier: Fixture checkout with configured upstream is reported no-upstream.

assumptions.statement: repo coord can be invoked from singularity-engine.
assumptions.falsifier: A live warning command exits non-zero or cannot resolve repo.
